definition: A line segment joining opposite corners of a cuboid through its inside, rather than across one face.
A pyramid whose apex is directly above the centre of its base.
A cone whose vertex is directly above the centre of its circular base.
On a right cone, the length $l$ from the vertex to the edge of the base along the sloping surface, so $l = \sqrt{r^{2} + h^{2}}$.
Half of a sphere, cut through its centre; a solid hemisphere has a curved surface and a flat circular face.

term: angle between a line and a plane
definition: The angle between the line and its projection on the plane: the line from where it meets the plane to the foot of a perpendicular dropped from it.
